correctness.rationale: From the integral Q_{2k} brackets, the Kirillov matrix is one appended covector v together with an invertible symplectic middle block multiplied by z=lambda(e_{2k}). Because z is one entry of v, b=min val(v)<=a=val(z). Over every chain ring, a primitive-vector symplectic basis reduction and an elementary 3-by-3 shift show the exact congruence pi^b J2 plus (k-2) copies of pi^a J2 plus a zero pair. The sizes of the images and kernels follow from ideals (pi^a). A disjoint case count gives H_(a,b), including all-zero and characteristic-two boundaries. The classical orbit method yields character counts only for p>2k-1. The standalone checker independently constructs the original bracket matrices and passes 17 exhaustive finite configurations including distinct ring types of the same length/residue size.

value.rationale: The index captures only generic field rank, and cannot describe torsion in the bilinear pairing over chain rings. Exact local Smith strata are natural coadjoint invariants governing nilpotent-group character degrees; this theorem simultaneously classifies all elementary divisors, their multiplicities and every permissible Lazard-range character degree for unbounded dimensions and ring lengths. The universal dependence only on residue size and length, across characteristic and ramification, is a structural result not a cosmetic small-field tabulation.
